title: Fix audio on MacBook Pro 2015-2017 (Cirrus Logic CS8409)
author: andyholst
body:
## Problem

MacBook Pro 2015-2017 with Cirrus Logic CS8409 audio codec has no speaker output. The in-tree snd_hda_codec_cs8409 driver doesn't properly configure the CS8409's speaker pins.

## Fix

Install the community snd_hda_macbookpro driver from https://github.com/davidjo/snd_hda_macbookpro using DKMS.

## Changes

| File | What it does |
|------|-------------|
| install/hardware/apple/fix-snd-hda-macbookpro.sh | Detects CS8409, clones driver, installs via DKMS |
| install/hardware/all.sh | Runs the new fix during hardware setup |
| migrations/1786391102.sh | Applies fix to existing Omarchy installs |
| test/shell.d/snd-hda-macbookpro-test.sh | 9 tests, all passing |

Fixes #11619
